title: cuda-native nvfatbin stub trace, schema 1
description: One JSON object per successful nvfatbin stub invocation, including invocation through the fatbinary alias. The images array preserves clang's member order and labels; no vendor fatbinary compatibility is claimed. The arch field names the architecture of the image, with its suffix; it is not required, so a record that does not carry it is still valid. The schema field is the record format; the release version is reported separately by --version.
